name: Cadnce
tagline: Coaching infrastructure for competitive teams that answer to a P&L.
positioning: Cadnce turns scrim footage, ranked ladders, and coach notes into a single performance system built for orgs coaching dozens of rosters at once.

hero.h1: Coach every roster like it's your flagship team.
hero.sub: Cadnce unifies VOD review, scrim scheduling, and player analytics so program directors can prove ROI on every hour of coaching — not just the wins that make highlight reels.

features.title: VOD review that ties to outcomes
features.description: Timestamp coaching notes directly on match footage, then link each note to the objective it improved. Reviews stop being folklore and start being data.

features.title: Scrim scheduling across rosters
features.description: Coordinate scrim blocks for every team in your org, sync to player calendars, and auto-flag athletes trending toward burnout hours.

features.title: Ranked telemetry, one ledger
features.description: Pull ladder history, agent picks, and role stats from every account into one athlete profile your analysts actually trust.

features.title: Coach accountability reporting
features.description: Give directors a weekly readout of coaching hours delivered, sessions attended, and measured skill deltas per athlete.

features.title: Playbook version control
features.description: Draft, publish, and revise strategy docs with a full history — so a strat that lost a bracket never quietly reappears.

features.title: Roster health signals
features.description: Surface early indicators of tilt, attendance drops, and communication breakdowns before they cost you a season.

testimonials.quote: We coach eleven rosters across three titles. Before Cadnce, our review process lived in Discord threads and lost VODs. Now every coaching hour maps to a measurable skill delta the board can read.
testimonials.name: Marisol Devereaux

testimonials.quote: The accountability reporting closed a debate we'd had for two years. We could finally show which coaches drove improvement instead of arguing over who felt effective.
testimonials.name: Tobias Reinhardt

testimonials.quote: Usage-based pricing meant we onboarded our academy teams without a budget fight. We only pay for the matches we actually analyze, and it scaled cleanly through playoffs.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For single rosters and academy squads getting their review process off Discord.
features: Pay only for matches you analyze

pricing.blurb: For multi-roster orgs coordinating scrims and coaching across titles.
features: Volume credit rates as you scale

pricing.blurb: For leagues and franchises with governance, SSO, and data residency needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Cadnce is the performance system for organizations that coach competitive players at scale — earnest tooling for the unglamorous work behind every win.
